crossing.input_code:
local m=emu.memType.nesInternalRam
local st=emu.read(0x300,m)
local sx=emu.read(0x4E0,m)
local scroll=emu.read(0x60,m)+256*emu.read(0x61,m)
local wx=sx+(scroll<1200 and scroll or 0)
local magic=emu.read(0x490,m)
local room=emu.read(0x72,m)
if not mode then mode=0;stopAt=420;phase=0;phaseStart=0;oldMagic=magic end
local keys={right=frame>=170,a=false,b=false,select=false}
if frame<170 then
 keys.select=(frame>=20 and frame<24)or(frame>=155 and frame<159)
 keys.b=frame>=50 and frame<54
elseif room==0x10 then
 if phase==0 and wx>=stopAt and magic>=10 then phase=1;phaseStart=frame;oldMagic=magic end
 if phase==1 then
  keys.right=false
  if st<2 then phase=2;phaseStart=frame end
 elseif phase==2 then
  keys.right=false;keys.select=frame-phaseStart<4
  if frame-phaseStart>=8 then keys.b=frame%12<3 end
  if magic<oldMagic then phase=3;phaseStart=frame end
 elseif phase==3 then
  keys.right=false
  if frame-phaseStart>=110 then phase=4;phaseStart=frame end
 elseif phase==4 then
  keys.select=frame-phaseStart<4
  if frame-phaseStart>=5 then phase=0;stopAt=wx+240 end
 else
  keys.a=frame%90<30
  keys.b=frame%90>=35 and frame%90<55 and frame%12<3
 end
end
emu.setInput(keys,0)
